What is the area of the right triangle $ABC$ shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
Since $m∠A=m∠C={45}^{∘}$ and $AB=BC,$ we have an isosceles right  triangle. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945897/assets/3f9a52834fe76f1560beec8580dbd91076a9f7c6ef980f410aa5bfe7da162c9c.png)

Therefore, the area of the triangle is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {20}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 400 \\  & =200.\end{aligned}
$$
